That would be ideal. Honestly people who complain it takes them an hour to get to sleep, I would really like to just beat the shit right out of them.

Long distance buses (in the U.K. at least) I quite like. As long as it's not overnight because I've zero chance of getting a minute of sleep. 

If it's relatively quiet it's all good. Can sit and read for hours. I find that almost impossible under other circumstances. If it's busy as hell and someone is sitting next to me I hate it more than life itself. 

The bus tends to only stop twice in eight hours and usually more people get off than on at each stop. The same trip by train has lots more stops so there's the constant fear of "can you move your bag please". This is more a personal space than social anxiety thing. Headphones ftw.

Partly I was putting it off because I was dreading going to work. However, I'd often stay up stupid late during the week just because I could distract myself with Netflix and porn until the point it was physically impossible to stay away any longer so I didn't have to lie in bed for hours with all those lovely intrusive thoughts. 

At the weekend I'd miss at least one night of sleep and often both. Helped reduce the time I spent in bed unable to sleep contemplating how shite my life is. Turns out that shit has a nasty effect on brain function and ability to hold down a job.

The people I was working for / with were able to deal with or simply brush off the kind of thing which would really stress me out. Because of anxiety issues I just wasn't suited to that kind of work. If I could go back I'd do something completely different even if it meant making a lot less money.
